name: Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension

criteria.description: Mean pulmonary arterial pressure (mPAP) ≥ 25 mmHg at rest measured by right heart catheterization
Pulmonary artery wedge pressure (PAWP) ≤ 15 mmHg to exclude left heart disease
Exclusion of other causes of pulmonary hypertension such as lung diseases, chronic thromboembolism, or left heart disease

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All major criteria (mPAP ≥ 25 mmHg, PAWP ≤ 15 mmHg, PVR > 3 Wood units) plus exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Right heart catheterization is the gold standard for diagnosis

pathognomonic.symptomName: Fatigue related to decreased cardiac output

occasional.symptomName: Abdominal distension due to hepatomegaly or ascites

occasional.notes: Especially in connective tissue disease-associated PAH

rare.symptomName: Hoarseness due to recurrent laryngeal nerve compression

laboratory: Elevated brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) or NT-proBNP
Autoantibodies in connective tissue disease-associated PAH
imaging: Right ventricular hypertrophy and dilation on echocardiogram
Enlarged pulmonary arteries on chest CT
Perfusion defects excluded by ventilation/perfusion scan
genetic: BMPR2 gene mutations in familial and idiopathic PAH
other: Right heart catheterization confirming elevated pulmonary arterial pressures
6-minute walk test showing reduced exercise capacity

distinguishingFeatures: Elevated pulmonary artery wedge pressure (>15 mmHg)
Treatment focused on underlying cardiac disease

redFlags: Rapid progression of dyspnea and syncope
Signs of right heart failure (jugular venous distension, peripheral edema)
references: Galiè N, Humbert M, Vachiery JL, et al. 2015 ESC/ERS Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of pulmonary hypertension. Eur Heart J. 2016 Jan 1;37(1):67-119.
Simonneau G, Montani D, Celermajer DS, et al. Haemodynamic definitions and updated clinical classification of pulmonary hypertension. Eur Respir J. 2019 Jan;53(1):1801913.
Thenappan T, Ormiston ML, Ryan JJ, Archer SL. Pulmonary arterial hypertension: pathogenesis and clinical management. BMJ. 2018 Mar 27;360:j5492.
